serp_refs: Marketplace scan: golf rugs use custom golf area rug, golf decor, home office, man cave, personalized name and non slip rug wording.
Marketplace scan: octopus rugs are searched with coastal, nautical, ocean, sea life, octopus skull, mandala, mosaic, watercolor and beach house terms.
Marketplace scan: teacher round rugs use personalized teacher name, classroom decor, round rug, reading corner, storytime and back-to-school modifiers.
keyword_evidence: Use long-tail keywords that separate the final motifs: personalized golf rug, octopus skull rug, blue octopus area rug, octopus mandala rug, octopus mosaic rug, vintage octopus rug, watercolor octopus rug, coastal octopus welcome mat and personalized teacher round rug.
buyer_summary: B057 buyers include golf fans decorating offices or man caves, coastal decor shoppers choosing octopus rugs in different art styles, and teachers buying custom round classroom rugs. Key concerns are visual specificity, personalization, room fit, size options, soft microfiber/memory foam feel and non slip backing.
purchase_concerns: Keep area-rug products decor-focused and avoid calling them small doormats when room mockups show larger rugs. For skull/octopus, use coastal gothic language without implying Halloween-only if not necessary. For teacher rug, keep classroom/storytime use central.
